boundary_validation: Explicit units, mismatched security/date/protocol, unsupported instrument and empty evidence
Candidate opt-in, snapshots, unknown events, zero quantity versus unavailable amounts
Checked integer sum overflow and compensated summation with nonfinite failure
Mutable enhanced page DTO and transaction collection cannot change authoritative amounts
Binary32 zero, low values, original fractional values, NaN, infinities, negative values and truncation
Matching source profile, partial minute coverage, missing date, intraday sampling and unavailable Combined
Requested historical date pagination, page/record/byte budgets, reconnect, timeout and cancellation
Mixed source connections, request order reversal, duplicate preservation and unique quantity prefixes
Ambiguous zero-quantity prefixes, fractional source quantities and quantity mismatch diagnostics
Live same-connection frozen-frame replay and cross-connection reconciliation rejection
limitations: Estimates are not actual per-record execution turnover
SourceEnumerated does not certify exchange coverage or an immutable intraday snapshot
Turnover profile evidence is caller supplied and scoped to one security/date/endpoint
AfterHours and Combined have no independent vendor-reported total in version 1
Offline trade pages without live provenance can align quantity boundaries but do not acquire full scope availability
Encoding-step bounds require explicit assumptions and are not vendor error guarantees
Legacy K-line amount zero/low-value behavior is corrected; unrelated volume helper uses are not generalized
